title: Arcane Archer
description:
Arcane Archer's gameplay revolves around shooting and detonating explosive arrows to make your way through the game's 12 stages as fast as you can! 

Take on increasingly difficult levels, and then test your skill against the online leaderboard! Experiment with different strategies and routes to give yourself an edge! 

The game also features a build-in speedrun timer and level select to help you practice certain levels and become the best archer you can be!
description_short: Arcane Archer is a 3D platforming FPS speedrun game where you must use explosive arrows to blast yourself across gaps and up walls to reach the goal! Use the power of your explosive arrows to parkour your way through an assortment of stages, and shoot for the top of the leaderboard!
